jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

We’re hiring a Deployment Strategist to lead the charge in deploying our AI agents into the complex and highly regulated environments of major banks and fintechs. You will be the bridge between our technology and our customers, ensuring our AI solutions solve real-world financial crime challenges while driving the expansion of our enterprise partnerships.

This role is a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and customer-facing leadership. You will work directly with our largest clients to design and implement deployment strategies that deliver measurable impact and inform the future of our platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end deployment of Bretton AI’s agents in highly regulated banking environments, ensuring the highest standards of quality and security.

  • Develop and execute custom implementation plans, workflow integrations, and training sessions for new enterprise clients.

  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams to expand enterprise contracts by identifying new use cases and opportunities within customer workflows.

  • Present results, insights, and proposals to a wide range of audiences, from technical analysts to C-suite banking executives.

  • Act as a critical feedback loop, embedding with product and engineering teams to translate customer insights into platform improvements.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in a B2B, customer-facing technical role such as AI deployment, product management, or strategy consulting.

  • Proven experience working with highly regulated industries, particularly banking or financial services.

  • A strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with banking executives.

  • A hands-on, problem-solving mindset with the ability to dig into granular details for enterprise customers.

  • Comfort and adaptability in a fast-paced environment, with a willingness to travel as needed.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with programming, scripting, or statistical packages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).

  • Previous experience at a startup, particularly in scaling customer deployments for enterprise clients.

  • A background in compliance, risk management, or financial services operations.

  • Experience presenting to C-suite executives and building executive-level relationships.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Direct Impact: You will see your work directly influence how major financial institutions combat financial crime.

  • Customer-Centric: You thrive at the intersection of technical solutions and customer success, solving real business problems.

  • Strategic Influence: Your deployment expertise will have a direct, measurable impact on our product and company trajectory.

  • High-Growth Environment: You are excited by the opportunity to build, innovate, and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative setting.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $170k - $200k + equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We’ve got you covered with DoorDash and an Uber home

Join us in building AI that protects the global financial system from financial crimes that fund terrorism, human trafficking, and other serious threats.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of bringing our AI agents to the banks and fintechs that are fighting financial crime on a global scale. In a landscape transformed by regulatory shifts and AI advancements, you will own the full sales cycle for our largest and most strategic accounts, working closely with key decision-makers in compliance, engineering, and risk.

This is a core sales role on our GTM team, where you will be a key part of a small and growing team. You will work directly with our founding executives to shape our go-to-market strategy, land new logos, and drive expansion within major financial institutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage executive stakeholders and multithread across large financial institutions to navigate complex sales cycles and move deals forward.

  • Deliver compelling demos and presentations that clearly articulate the value of our AI agents to compliance and risk leaders.

  • Lead pricing and contract negotiations in highly regulated environments.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to design tailored solutions and share insights from the field to inform our go-to-market strategy.

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting and relationship building.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of success in B2B Enterprise sales with a proven track record of exceeding quota.

  • Experience selling technical products to the financial services industry, preferably in compliance, risk, or security.

  • A strong grasp of complex sales cycles with average deal sizes ranging from six figures to $1M+.

  • Confidence and presence when selling to technical stakeholders, including VP and C-level executives in compliance, engineering, and risk.

  • A true closer’s mindset: persistent, strategic, consultative, and always driving for the next step.

  • A self-starter with a builder mentality and the ability to operate independently within a lean, agile team.

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience at a startup or on a founding sales team.

  • A background in financial services or fintech sales.

  • Experience selling into compliance, risk, or regulatory functions.

  • A track record of success at high-growth B2B software companies.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • High-Impact Sales: You thrive at the intersection of consultative sales and customer impact, solving real business problems.

  • Strategic Contribution: Your sales contributions will have a direct, measurable impact on how financial institutions adopt AI to combat crime.

  • Build and Shape: You are excited by the opportunity to be a foundational member of a growing sales team and influence GTM strategy.

  • Uncapped Potential: You will have a competitive OTE with uncapped commission and meaningful equity in a high-growth company.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive OTE (base + uncapped commission) & equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We’ve got you covered with DoorDash and an Uber home

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

As a Sales Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between our Account Executives and our prospective customers, playing a critical role in how they understand, adopt, and succeed with our AI agents. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will combine your technical credibility with your sales acumen to demonstrate value, build trust, and accelerate deals.

You will be the technical voice of the customer, translating their needs into solutions and providing invaluable feedback to our product and engineering teams. You will get to show prospects how cutting-edge AI can transform their compliance operations, presenting to both CTOs and Chief Compliance Officers.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives to scope and deliver compelling, customized demos that are tailored to the specific business needs of our prospects.

  • Develop proof-of-concepts and prototypes that showcase how our AI agents can solve our customers’ most pressing problems.

  • Present our technical solutions to both business and technical stakeholders in a clear and persuasive manner.

  • Confidently handle technical objections, including questions about integration, compliance, and performance.

  • Collaborate with our Product and Engineering teams to provide feedback from the field and influence our product roadmap.

  • Contribute to our sales enablement materials, demo environments, and best practices to help scale the impact of our sales engineering team.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • A strong technical background in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical consulting.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into tangible business value.

  • Comfortable building quick prototypes and debugging code in real-time.

  • A consultative, customer-first mindset with a passion for creative problem-solving.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in fintech, compliance, or with AI products.

  • A background in a customer-facing technical role.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Bridge the Gap: You love being the technical expert in the room and enjoy the customer-facing side of technology.

  • High-Impact Role: You will blend deep technical knowledge with business strategy to help close deals and drive revenue.

  • Shape the Product: You will be the voice of the customer, providing critical feedback that influences our product roadmap.

  • Solve a Critical Problem: You will be at the forefront of helping financial institutions use AI to fight financial crime.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary + equity + commission

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We’ve got you covered with DoorDash and an Uber home

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

We’re hiring Product Engineers who excel at turning complex customer problems into elegant technical solutions. You’ll own substantial features from conception to production, working directly with customers to understand their needs, designing scalable architectures, and shipping code that measurably improves compliance operations.

This role combines deep technical work with high customer impact. You’ll build systems that process thousands of cases, save compliance teams significant time, and directly contribute to company revenue.

What You’ll Build

  • Develop intuitive interfaces for case management, reporting, and analytics.

  • Build document analysis and verification systems.

  • Build agentic workflows that coordinate AI tools and data services to perform research, enrichment, and verification, while keeping humans in the loop for review.

  • Create tools that help customers configure and customize their compliance workflows.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 4+ years (Engineer) / 6+ years (Sr. Engineer) / 8+ years (Staff Engineer) of experience building production software.

  • Strong full-stack capabilities, including backend services, APIs, databases, and (nice-to-have) frontend development.

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing products where reliability is critical.

  • An end-to-end ownership mindset, from requirements gathering through deployment and iteration.

  • Clear communication skills—you can explain technical decisions to diverse audiences.

  • Product thinking—you understand why you’re building something, not just how.

Valued Experience:

  • Building workflow engines, orchestration systems, or process automation tools.

  • Working in regulated industries where compliance, auditability, and data integrity are critical.

  • Integrating AI/LLM capabilities into production applications.

  • Creating configuration systems, admin tools, or workflow builders for non-technical users.

  • Designing systems for multi-tenancy, versioning, or complex authorization models.

  • A strong foundation in data modeling and distributed systems.

Technical Skills:

We work with a mix of TypeScript, Python, Node.js, React, cloud infrastructure, and workflow orchestration frameworks. You don’t need prior experience with our exact stack, but you should be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and applying them in production.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Meaningful Work: Solve hard problems that help financial institutions fight fraud and manage risk.

  • Technical Complexity: Build AI agents, workflow engines, data pipelines, and sophisticated UIs.

  • Customer Connection: Work directly with users, see your impact, and iterate based on real feedback.

  • True Ownership: Ship features that matter, influence product direction, and own outcomes.

  • High Growth: Join during a phase where your contributions will shape the company’s future.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $168k - $213k base salary + meaningful equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We cover DoorDash and Uber home

Join us in building AI that protects the global financial system from financial crimes that fund terrorism and human trafficking.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

We’re hiring Platform Engineers to build and operate the infrastructure that powers compliance at scale.

You’ll own reliability, performance, and scalability across our core systems. You will design Postgres schemas, optimize queries, build high-throughput services, orchestrate long-running workflows (Temporal), and maintain our commitment to 99.9%+ uptime for customers processing thousands of cases per day.

You’ll write production backend code, design distributed systems, and own the infrastructure that empowers our product teams to ship fast without breaking production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build APIs and services that handle thousands of concurrent requests.

  • Architect ingestion → assessment → delivery pipelines for our cases.

  • Implement Temporal workflows for long-running, stateful processes.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and queries for our compliance workflows.

  • Own CI/CD, deployments, and infrastructure-as-code, and drive observability through logging, tracing, and metrics.

  • Debug slow queries, memory leaks, and race conditions in our production environment.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years (Engineer) / 6+ years (Sr. Engineer) / 8+ years (Staff Engineer) of backend or infrastructure experience.

  • Strong systems fundamentals, including distributed systems, databases, APIs, and concurrency.

  • Proven production experience, including debugging live systems, incident response, and on-call rotations.

  • PostgreSQL expertise, including query optimization, indexing, schema design, and migrations.

  • An ownership mindset: you close the loop, write postmortems, and prevent the recurrence of issues.

Technical Skills

  • Languages: TypeScript/Node.js (primary), SQL (advanced), Python (nice to have).

  • Databases: PostgreSQL/Supabase, RLS, query planning.

  • Workflow: Temporal (preferred) or Airflow/Prefect/Cadence.

  • Cloud/Infra: AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

  • Monitoring: Datadog (or Grafana/Prometheus/New Relic/Sentry).

Bonus

  • Fintech/RegTech experience (security, audit logging).

  • AI/LLM infrastructure experience (prompt orchestration, token limits, cost management).

  • Experience with high-throughput systems and chaos/resilience testing.

  • VPC architecture and cloud networking (security groups, private endpoints, compliance requirements).

About you

You are motivated by the opportunity to join a startup at our stage because you want to build something fast and have a direct impact—not because you need extensive structure. You are energized by combining technical work with customer interaction. You love solving open-ended problems, asking good questions, and structuring solutions without needing perfect specifications upfront.

You make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and proactively pull in the right people to overcome blockers. You are adaptable when priorities shift and have a growth mindset. You understand the broader system you’re working in—not just what the AI does, but how it fits into the customer’s full workflow.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $168k - $213k base salary + meaningful equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We cover DoorDash and Uber home

Join us in building AI that protects the global financial system from financial crimes that fund terrorism and human trafficking.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the foundation that enables us to deploy secure, compliant AI systems at major financial institutions fighting financial crime at a massive scale. Our infrastructure is built on a modern, container-native architecture, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to deliver consistent, auditable deployments across diverse customer environments.

You will work directly with our largest customers—institutions serving over a billion people—to architect, automate, and harden our on-premises and cloud environments to meet the strictest regulatory and performance requirements, including SOC 2 compliance. Your work will be informed by real customer needs and will ship to everyone, so you must build enterprise-grade systems, work effectively with engineering and customer teams, understand financial services compliance, and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve our Kubernetes infrastructure, including cluster management, service mesh configuration, and container security policies.

  • Design and implement progressive delivery pipelines with canary deployments, automated rollbacks, and deployment health validation.

  • Build and maintain our observability infrastructure in Datadog, including dashboards, monitors, SLOs, and distributed tracing.

  • Drive incident response for high-severity outages and proactively model capacity needs for low-latency AI inference.

  • Architect and automate secure infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code for VPCs, IAM policies, Kubernetes manifests, and private cloud deployments.

  • Maintain and improve the infrastructure controls that support our SOC 2 compliance posture.

  • Lead customer engagements for enterprise rollouts and mentor mid-level engineers on infrastructure best practices.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure engineering or DevOps at high-growth or hyperscale companies.

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including production cluster management, Helm, and service mesh technologies.

  • A proven track record of architecting and operating AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure at an enterprise scale.

  • Experience with observability platforms, preferably Datadog (metrics, logs, APM, distributed tracing).

  • A strong background in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Helm, Kustomize) and safe deployment practices (progressive delivery, canary deployments, GitOps, automated rollbacks).

  • "Battle scars" from leading outages, capacity events, and large-scale incident reviews.

  • Strong programming skills in Python.

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity with TypeScript.

  • Direct involvement in SOC 2 or other compliance audit preparation or remediation.

  • Direct experience with private-cloud or on-premises deployments for regulated customers.

  • Previous experience at startups scaling infrastructure from the early stages to the enterprise level.

  • A background in fintech or building systems for highly regulated industries.

  • Experience with AI/ML infrastructure and model deployment at scale.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Build for Scale: You thrive at the intersection of technical leadership and customer impact, building systems that enable rapid development while maintaining the highest standards of security, compliance, and reliability.

  • Infrastructure as a Product: You see infrastructure as a product for your engineering peers and understand the value of platform automation in enabling developer velocity.

  • High-Impact Work: Your contributions will have a direct, measurable impact on how financial institutions adopt AI to fight crime.

  • Flexible leave options

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

As our Field Marketing Manager, you will be the architect and executor of our presence at industry events, conferences, and field activations. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you will own our event strategy end-to-end—identifying the right opportunities, designing compelling experiences, and generating qualified pipeline for our sales team.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, and leadership to ensure every event we attend drives measurable business outcomes. This is a role for a creative, data-driven marketer who thrives on execution and can see the direct impact of their work on the company's growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own and execute the end-to-end event strategy for conferences, trade shows, and field activations in the financial services and compliance space.

  • Manage all event logistics, including booth design and setup, vendor coordination, staffing plans, and shipping.

  • Plan and execute hosted events such as executive dinners, happy hours, and roundtable discussions to build relationships with key prospects and customers.

  • Partner with Sales to develop pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up strategies that maximize pipeline generation from every event.

  • Build and manage the field marketing budget, tracking spend against pipeline and ROI targets.

  • Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to create compelling event collateral, presentations, and demo materials.

Report on event performance with clear metrics, sharing insights and recommendations to continuously improve our strategy.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 3-5 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation, ideally in a B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Proven experience managing complex event logistics end-to-end, from planning through execution and post-event analysis.

  • A strong track record of generating measurable pipeline from events and field programs.

  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with sales teams.

  • Willingness to travel 30-40% of the time for events.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience marketing to the financial services, compliance, or RegTech industry.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies.

  • A background in a high-growth startup environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Own the Stage: You will have full ownership of our field presence and the creative freedom to build something impactful from the ground up.

  • Direct Business Impact: You will see a direct line between the events you run and the revenue the company generates.

  • Mission-Driven Work: You will help bring to market AI that protects the financial system from crime, a message that resonates deeply with our audience.

  • High-Growth Environment: You will be an early member of the marketing team, giving you the opportunity to shape the function and grow your career.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $140k - $160k base salary + meaningful equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Working late? We've got you covered with DoorDash and an Uber home

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

As our Founding Product Marketer, you will be the architect of our narrative, the champion of our customers, and the engine of our go-to-market strategy. This is a career-defining opportunity to build and lead the product marketing function at a high-growth, vertical AI company, establishing Bretton AI as the undisputed leader in AI-powered compliance.

You will work at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing to translate our sophisticated AI technology into clear, compelling business outcomes that resonate with financial institutions. Your work will directly shape our brand, empower our sales team, and solidify our position as the essential infrastructure for AI in compliance.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve Bretton AI’s corporate and product messaging for all target personas, including BSA Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and technical buyers.

  • Create and maintain a comprehensive suite of sales enablement tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, demo scripts, ROI calculators, and objection handling guides.

  • Partner with the CEO and content team to build and operate an AI-native content engine that produces personalized use case content and compelling customer stories.

  • Lead marketing efforts for all product launches, feature releases, and integrated campaigns by writing messaging briefs and coordinating cross-functional execution.

  • Serve as the expert on our competitors, buyers, and market landscape through continuous research and intelligence synthesis.

  • Collaborate with the deployments team to develop powerful customer stories, case studies, testimonials, and video content from our top accounts.

  • Track and report on the impact of product marketing initiatives on sales pipeline, win rates, and sales cycle times.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years in B2B product marketing, with at least 2 years at an enterprise software company selling to large, complex organizations.

  • Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., fintech, banking, insurance, healthcare) and a deep understanding of buyers who operate under intense regulatory scrutiny.

  • A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business value. Experience with AI, machine learning, or data-intensive products is a strong plus.

  • Mastery of messaging and positioning, with the ability to articulate a unique point of view and build narratives that cut through the noise.

  • Exceptional writing and communication skills, with a portfolio that demonstrates your ability to craft everything from punchy headlines to detailed whitepapers.

  • A track record of successful sales enablement, with tools that sales teams love and that measurably improve performance.

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity with the financial crime compliance space (e.g., KYC, AML, sanctions screening).

  • Experience with analyst relations (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Celent).

  • A background in fintech or building messaging for highly regulated industries.

  • Experience with AI-native content workflows and a passion for leveraging new technologies to create content at scale.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Build from the Ground Up: You get to define the product marketing function and shape the narrative of a category-defining company.

  • Strategic Impact: Your work will directly influence revenue, market perception, and customer success.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: You will be a key player at the table with sales, product, and the executive team.

  • Solve a Critical Problem: You will be at the forefront of helping financial institutions use AI to fight financial crime.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $155k - $220k + equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

  • Professional development budget for conferences, courses, and books

  • Working late? We’ve got you covered with DoorDash and an Uber home

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work directly with customers to deploy and integrate Bretton’s platform in real-world environments. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, customer deployments, and product discovery, helping customers implement Bretton’s technology in complex enterprise environments while uncovering insights that improve and scale the product.

What You'll Do

  • Deploy Bretton's AI agents at banks, fintechs, and payments companies, navigating the security and compliance requirements that come with regulated environments.

  • Travel onsite to work through last-mile connectivity challenges, from wiring up core banking integrations to resolving edge cases that only surface in live production.

  • Partner with BSA officers, AML analysts, and risk teams to translate their workflows and regulatory requirements into agent behavior that reflects how their business actually works.

  • Build the connectors, configuration tools, and internal frameworks that turn one-off customer solutions into repeatable platform capabilities.

  • Guide customers from demo through go-live as a trusted technical advisor, helping them resolve issues quickly and expand the value they get from Bretton.

  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and GTM to remove blockers and do whatever it takes to make customers successful.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues in real deployments by reproducing problems and collaborating with the engineering team to fix them.

  • Translate customer usage into product insights by sharing customer needs with engineering and product teams and identifying opportunities to turn recurring solutions into product features.

Technical Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience as a software engineer or similar

  • Strong backend or data engineering background

  • Experience with Python, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., solutions engineer, forward deployed engineer, or technical implementation role) is a plus.

  • Actively building with LLMs and modern AI systems is a must

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to explain AI systems to non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving mindset

  • Comfort working with enterprise customers

Compensation & Benefits

  • $150k - $200k base salary + meaningful equity

  • Comprehensive healthcare, 401k matching, commuter benefits

  • 15 days PTO + holidays, unlimited sick days

  • Flexible leave options

jobs.title: AI Operations Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bretton AI

Bretton AI is the leading AI agent platform for financial services. Companies like Robinhood, Mercury and Gusto trust us to automate mission critical work, starting with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism investigations.

We’ve raised over $95M from Greylock, Y Combinator, Thomson Reuters Ventures and other top tier investors. We’re based in downtown San Francisco and our team comes from world-class organizations like SpaceX, Google, Netflix, Stripe, Plaid and more.

The Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented, analytically-minded person to join our AI Operations team. You'll be on the front lines of ensuring our AI agents are performant for banks and fintechs fighting financial crime at scale — monitoring quality, testing new features, and working directly with engineering and customers to keep our platform running at its best.

This is a rare opportunity to learn how cutting-edge AI systems work in production while making a real impact on global financial security.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI agents to ensure they meet the highest standards for compliance teams at banks and fintechs

  • Test new features and custom logic before they go live for customers

  • Analyze case data to identify patterns, issues, and opportunities for improvement

  • Work directly with engineering to understand and measure the impact of system changes

  • Learn state-of-the-art AI monitoring techniques including performance drift detection, human scoring pipelines, and dataset preparation

  • Support our largest customers by providing operational insights and recommendations

  • Partner with product and engineering to translate operational findings into platform improvements

What Success Looks Like

  • Month 1: Master our AI platform and learn complex compliance workflows. Shadow experienced team members and begin conducting your first case reviews.

  • Month 2: Take ownership of operational support for major customer deployments. Conduct detailed quality assessments and partner with engineering to improve system performance.

  • Ongoing: Become the go-to expert for AI operations, conducting critical reviews that directly shape product development and customer success.

What We're Looking For
